notes: Synthetic people only: every name is invented and every address is @example.test.
answers[] is a ledger: a question may appear more than once; the latest answered_at at or before a date wins (PROFILING_V2.md §7.1).
value is 0-5 for scale questions; fit.<role>.arch_illustration takes one of the select options.

expected.primary / expected.secondary for kind "archetype" and "blend" is the ground truth the persona was written to be, not what any engine returned. The baseline report prints what the engine of the day returns.
checkpoints[] (kind "evolution") are computed with the reference model and the parameters below; displayed is what the card shows under hysteresis, computed is the nearest centroid on that day.
evidence[] axis values are RADAR_AXES keys; source names are provisional until S9 publishes the tool map (PROFILING_V2.md §5.3).
Coach has no personas: the coach bank asks no archetype-trait questions today (PROFILING_V2.md §2.4).

personas.name: Oscar Oscillate
personas.story: A Network Amplifier who re-answers as a Hands-On Partner on 5 March, back again on 12 March (7 days: too short to change the displayed archetype), then for good on 1 May.

personas.name: Aria Ageing
personas.story: A Sage Guide who answered everything on 1 September 2025 and never again, and hosted four sessions that autumn. Uniform ageing leaves the archetype unchanged; the questions become re-askable after six months; the evidence fades after twelve.
